verdict.rationale: Ironclad offers webhooks, APIs to trigger/launch workflows, and integration patterns (e.g., linking to procurement systems) that can be orchestrated into background automations, but this requires external glue code/middleware rather than a native 'autonomous agent' or scheduled automation builder within Ironclad itself. missing for 10: a first-party autonomous agent/scheduler feature, evidence of AI-driven decision loops running unattended, and independent confirmation of such automations working in production.
